title: Stores
description: The stores gamebus knows, in umu-database's spelling, with the other spellings launchers use. The page schema's store keys must equal the ids here that are not standalone.

id_precedence.description: Stores whose codename lends a page its canonical id, best first. Each must be a store listed below.

store.description: In the order a picker offers them.

aliases.description: Other spellings launchers use for this store, lowercase.

pick.description: Whether a store picker offers it.

standalone.description: umu-database's word for no store. Never a page key.
